lines.text: A tiny software change in July took down Microsoft email in November.
Load tests used weaker machines. The bug only showed up on bigger, newer ones.
lines.title: Why tests missed it

lines.text: Teams traffic surged while some capacity was offline. Together, they woke the bug.
lines.title: The trigger

lines.text: Each failing server sent its traffic to the next one, which failed too.
lines.title: Cascading failure

lines.text: Within two hours, more than eighty percent of gateway servers stopped responding.
lines.title: At the worst point

lines.text: Rolling back was not possible because the change was months old. Engineers patched the patch instead.
lines.title: The fix

lines.text: Test on real hardware, and plan for recovery when everything is down.
lines.title: Takeaways
